prompt: In what year was the former South Korean prime minister who is from the same clan as the oldest member of the band BTS born?
answer: The former prime minister was **Kim Hwang-sik**, who belongs to the **Gwangsan Kim clan**, the same clan as BTS’s oldest member, Jin (Kim Seok-jin). Kim Hwang-sik was born in **1948**.
